The Dominant Architecture of Transformer-based 
LLMs
 GPT-3:
– Decoder-only Transformer
– Causal attention
– LayerNorm, residual blocks, etc.
 Modern LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral, DeepSeek, etc.):
– Same core architecture
– Sometimes improved normalization or efficiency
– Minor architectural refinements
– But the core is the same.

Agenda
1. The Foundation: Transformer Architecture & Training 
Paradigms
2. From Raw Models to Useful Assistants: Instruction 
Tuning
3. Human Alignment: RLHF, PPO, and DPO
4. Mixture of Experts Models
5. Reasoning Models: Chain-of-Thought and Beyond

Transformer
Encoder Only
Uses: NLU, classification, feature extraction
Examples: BERT, RoBERTa, DeBERTa
Encoder-Decoder
Uses: NLG, translation, summarisation, seq2seq 
mapping
Examples: T5, Flan-T5, BART
Decoder Only
Uses: NLG, translation, summarisation, completion
Examples: GPT-x, LLaMa, every other new model today

Another ornament: Positional encodings
Transformers lack a built-in notion of word order.To e n c o d e position information, we add a positional vectorto each input embedding.In the original Transformer, fixed sinusoidal positional encodings were used (i.e. sinusoidal functions of different frequencies)
